justification.dataset: DANDI:000582 (Sargolini/Moser dorsocaudal MEC open-field foraging) is the canonical grid-cell dataset, the exact choice an expert would make.
justification.handling: Real NWB data streamed via remfile with correct LED-position alignment, occupancy normalization, and min-occupancy masking, but all sorted units are used with no stated quality/inclusion criteria.
justification.analysis: Textbook rotational-autocorrelogram grid score with an appropriate circular-shift null and a 95th-percentile threshold, all standard and correctly implemented.
justification.correctness: Every reported number (24/91, threshold 1.01, median spacing 54 cm, max 1.87) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Autocorrelograms show unmistakable hexagonal rings, rate maps show discrete fields, axes carry units, and the gallery examples are the true top cells by grid score.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the modular/orientation claims are appropriately hedged, but no specific limitation (single-lab, pooled null, no unit filtering) is named, keeping a genuinely clean result at 3 rather than 4.
